text: {"status":"CONFLICT","claims":[{"text":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account is prohibited, which includes Confidential information.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, such as a personal Dropbox, personal Google Drive or personal OneDrive, is prohibited."},{"text":"Confidential information must never be stored in personal cloud storage.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Confidential and Restricted information must never be stored in personal cloud storage."},{"text":"Confidential information must never be stored in personal accounts, including personal cloud-storage accounts.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"It must never be stored on personal devices or in personal accounts, including personal email and personal cloud-storage accounts."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":["E1","E2"],"conflict_note":"E1 prohibits uploading Internal or above information to personal cloud-storage accounts, while E2 allows Internal information in personal cloud-storage accounts with multi-factor authentication. For Confidential information, both E2 and E3 say it must never be stored in personal cloud storage."}
